description: Connect your TimeLodge account to start, pause, resume, and stop your timer; check active work; review weekly timesheets; and add or correct completed time entries. Interactive timer and timesheet panels let you control your timer, browse weekly totals, and edit eligible entries directly in ChatGPT. Authorized users can manage clients and projects, find billable work, prepare draft invoices, and send invoices after confirming the recipient and contents. Access follows your existing workspace permissions and subscription. One active timer is supported per person across workspaces.

defaultPrompt: Show my current timer and whether it is running or paused.
Show my timesheet for this week with daily and billable totals.
Help me prepare a draft invoice from approved work. Do not send it.
